dataset_title: Curated Weak Password Corpus (OWASP ASVS V6.2.4 Compliant)
target_standard: NIST SP 800-63B-4 Section 3.1.1.2 & OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 V6.2.4/V6.2.8/V6.2.12

common_passwords.description: Top authentic real-world passwords from public corpuses and breach summaries

numeric_patterns.description: Sequential digits, repeated runs, PINs, and date patterns

keyboard_patterns.description: Spatial keyboard walks across QWERTY, keypad, and diagonal layouts

dictionary_patterns.description: Common dictionary nouns, adjectives, pop culture terms

admin_patterns.description: Default administrative, networking, service, and role accounts

word_number_patterns.description: Dictionary words combined with predictable numeric suffixes

other_weak_patterns.description: Repetitive phrases, idioms, and common security-avoidance patterns

provenance.license: Public Domain / CC0 Universal / Research Benchmark
provenance.pii_leak_containment: Zero PII, zero email:password pairs, zero salt/hashes, zero live user data
